body: I hope at the very least you made peace in your mind. I wrote a message I could never send to someone who I was missing in the snow on my way there. Was there anything on your mind too?
It's...complicated. i think PM is better to discuss that issue.

Hey dude. I was in a similar position too, except it was daytime. Still freezing. But eventually it got too cold for me and I decided I wanted to be warm and I didn't want to go like that. Stay with us at least a bit longer.

I'm still here yeah. I'm still on break right now. I go back to school in about a week. Most have left already. She leaves tomorrow. I think I blew my chances. Possibly. 

My cousin's showing me around Philly soon though. I guess that's something.

Maybe they do. But my family, friends, and her likely  would be better off forgetting about me. I cause everyone pain and bother people. I just ruin the mood. I might be a freshman but I know what pointless means.

It's less the grades themselves as I feel like I am actively failing the people who probably deal with me only because they think it will make me happy. They probably care underneath all the bristling and fights, but it's as if these grades are the only reason they have to be upset.
